subject: P1 external-only swarm memory enforcement gap — first Manager audit
summary: Read-only Manager audit of current main 1c1672a4e2ca8087684b6c3dcb4519a8fc49023b confirms the P1 directive is durably referenced in GitHub and issue #153 records successful canonical Artifactory publication, but repository enforcement remains incomplete. The latest P1 commit adds only an AgentBus backup pointer and does not add bootstrap/runtime enforcement or regression tests. Existing architecture is already substantially external-state oriented: AGENT_BOOTSTRAP declares INTERNAL_ARTIFACTORY forum authority, forum/master-handoff-before-mutation, durable context recovery, and current authoritative forum loading; GLOBAL_AGENT_ENTRYPOINT requires authoritative project forum/master handoff/current accepted state; agent_state_handoff makes internal Artifactory canonical when configured and GitHub a mirror; the internal scheduler explicitly avoids dependence on an active model session remembering to continue and persists receipts to registered Artifactory or another already-authorized external degraded route. However, these surfaces do not yet expose one explicit machine-readable invariant that native ChatGPT memory is forbidden as swarm protocol recall/cache/log/fallback/persistence. Recommended Primary-owned remediation: add a canonical external-swarm-persistence rule and machine-readable bootstrap fields declaring native_chatgpt_memory_for_swarm_state=DENY, native_memory_fallback=DENY, external_state_precedence=ARTIFACTORY_THEN_VERIFIED_GITHUB, allowed_durable_swarm_state_stores limited to INTERNAL_ARTIFACTORY plus the authorized GitHub repository, and external_state_unavailable=FAIL_CLOSED_AFFECTED_PERSISTENCE_BRANCH; wire the invariant through AGENT_BOOTSTRAP, GLOBAL_AGENT_ENTRYPOINT, AGENT_CONTEXT_REFERENCE, agent-state handoff, scheduler/continuation paths, and package templates; add negative regression tests proving no native-memory fallback and positive readback tests for independent Artifactory/GitHub verification and precedence; refresh MASTER_HANDOFF after accepted deployment. Repository MASTER_HANDOFF is currently generation 7 from 2026-10-05 and therefore does not reflect the 2026-10-07 P1 state; because this Manager has no direct internal Artifactory read surface in this conversation, treat that only as repository-mirror drift evidence, not proof that canonical Artifactory handoff state is stale. This message is evidence/recommendation only and conveys no mutation or deployment authority.
